description.zh:
驱动通道ID列表。调用[QueryEdgeInstanceChannel](~~162253~~)接口获取通道ID。

> 单次调用最多可填写20个通道ID。
description.en:
List of driver channel IDs. You can obtain channel IDs by invoking the [QueryEdgeInstanceChannel](~~162253~~) API.  

> You can specify up to 20 channel IDs in a single invocation.

description.zh:
驱动ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**驱动管理**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标驱动名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用[QueryEdgeDriver](~~155776~~)接口获取。
description.en:
Driver ID. You can obtain the ID by hovering your mouse over the target driver name on the **Driver Management** page in the [edge computing console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list).  

You can also obtain it by invoking the [QueryEdgeDriver](~~155776~~) API.

description.zh:
边缘实例的ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**边缘实例**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用[QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~)接口获取。
description.en:
ID of the edge instance. You can obtain the ID by hovering your mouse over the target edge instance name on the **Edge Instances** page in the [edge computing console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list).  

You can also obtain it by invoking the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) API.

description.zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入。
description.en: Instance ID. Do not specify this parameter for public instances. Specify it for Enterprise instances.

title.zh: 批量查询边缘实例中的驱动通道
title.en: Batch query driver channels in an edge instance

descriptions.zh:
## 限制条件
单阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为5。

> RAM用户共享主账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Condition  
The maximum queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account calling this API is 5.  

> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
